name: Marinara Engine
description: A local, AI-powered chat, roleplay, and game engine built around one idea: you install it, you run it, and it just works. Oh, and don't forget about the part where you have fun! ALSO, HEY, LOOK, IT'S FREE.
author: furglitch.githubsecurity.clustered014@passmail.net

installation.content:
#!/bin/bash

echo "== [Calagopus Installer] -- Installing Dependencies =="
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y curl git

echo "== [Calagopus Installer] -- Configuring Working Directory =="
cd /mnt/server
git config --global --add safe.directory /mnt/server

echo "== [Calagopus Installer] -- Cloning Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Engine, ${VERSION:-main} branch =="
git clone -b "${VERSION:-main}" https://github.com/Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Engine.git .

echo "== [Calagopus Installer] -- Generating Admin Secret =="
ADMIN_SECRET=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
echo "!!! CRITICAL !!!"
echo "Admin secret below! Make sure to copy this to put it in your panel!"
echo "ADMIN_SECRET=$ADMIN_SECRET"
echo "ADMIN_SECRET=$ADMIN_SECRET" >> ./.env
echo "You can find this in your .env file later if you forget it."

echo "== [Calagopus Installer] -- Preparing Executable =="
chmod +x start.sh

echo "== [Calagopus Installer] -- Installation Complete =="

variables.name: Automatic Updates
variables.description: Git-based Windows, macOS/Linux, and Termux launchers update the Engine by default. Set false to keep the installed Engine version. The launcher still prints a reminder when a newer published release is available, and manual update controls remain available.

variables.name: Allowed IPs
variables.description:
IP Allowlist — comma-separated IPs or CIDRs (e.g. 192.168.1.100,10.0.0.0/24)
When set, all other IPs are blocked. Loopback (127.0.0.1/::1) is always allowed.

variables.name: Trusted Hosts
variables.description: Public/reverse-proxy hostnames accepted by the HTTP Host check. IP addresses, localhost, .local/.home.arpa names, and single-label LAN/container names work automatically. Comma-separated; ports are ignored.

variables.name: Trusted Origins
variables.description:
Add an entry here ONLY for origins the auto-trust does not cover:
  - A public IP/hostname (e.g. http://203.0.113.10:7831)
  - A reverse-proxy domain (e.g. https://chat.example.com)
  - A Tailscale MagicDNS hostname (e.g. http://my-box.tailnet.ts.net:7860)
Comma-separated. Set to * only if you intentionally trust every browser origin that can reach this server.

variables.name: Basic Auth Userrname
variables.description:
HTTP Basic Auth — set both BASIC_AUTH_USER and BASIC_AUTH_PASS to require a username/password on every request from non-loopback, non-allowlisted IPs.
Use a strong, random password and pair with HTTPS (SSL_CERT/SSL_KEY) when exposing the server to the internet.

variables.name: Basic Auth Password
variables.description:
HTTP Basic Auth — set both BASIC_AUTH_USER and BASIC_AUTH_PASS to require a username/password on every request from non-loopback, non-allowlisted IPs.
Use a strong, random password and pair with HTTPS (SSL_CERT/SSL_KEY) when exposing the server to the internet.

variables.name: Enable Third-Party Extensions
variables.description:
Third-party Personal Extension imports. 
This is only the first gate; users must also opt in under Settings > Advanced > Danger Zone. 
Professor Mari drafts do not require this flag.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: Branch to pull from GitHub. Can be `main` or `staging`

variables.name: Launch Browser on Startup
variables.description:
Shell launchers open the local URL by default. Set false to disable.
! Egg firmly locked to false to prevent resource hogging.
